author: Claire Lewis
description:
If last week's mysterious Mass Effect: Universe trailer leak wasn't painful enough for you in the wake of BioWare's sudden closure, we've gotten yet another taste of The Game That Could Have Been, this time courtesy of award-winning video game composer Austin Wintory.

title: Here’s Another Mass Effect 5 Leak To Break Your Heart

author: Cameron Koch
description:
World of Warcraft: Forever's release is just around the corner, but developer Blizzard is making one final pass at the game's racial abilities before launch in response to beta feedback.

In a forum post, WoW community manager Kaivax posted a list of significant changes to many of each race's unique abilities that players expressed concerns about during Forever's beta. Those changes include tweaks to tauren, humans, orcs, dwarves, and Skyborne elves.

"In taking a final pass on these, we've prioritized racial identity, which means that some races will naturally be slightly more effective than others at certain combat roles," Blizzard said. "In some places where we had replaced role or class-focuse
title: WoW: Forever Just Got A Major Racial Ability Shakeup Just Before Launch

author: Cameron Koch
description:
Diablo 4's War Plans system is getting a major upgrade in Season 16, giving players even more control over their endgame activities and rewards.

Developer Blizzard introduced War Plans earlier this year as part of the game's second (and last) expansion, Lord of Hatred. It's an endgame system where players can essentially create a playlist of endgame activities, along the way ranking up those activities via a skill tree to make them even more rewarding.

It was a welcome addition, but unfortunately only gave players minimal control over what activities would appear as part of their plans. Players could also only reroll their War Plans a limited number of times, meaning if you didn't like a particular activity, oftentimes you were stuck having to do
title: Diablo 4’s War Plans Are Getting A Huge Upgrade In Season 16

author: S.E. Doster
description:
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 players have discovered an Easter egg on one of the multiplayer maps, which is tied to the 3D printer feature found in the DMZ extraction mode. This secret printer lets players grab different gun builds mid-match, and these weapons are fully customized with attachments.

As previously discovered by Muggs1213 on Reddit, Modern Warfare 4's Cachette multiplayer map contains one of DMZ's 3D printers. In DMZ, this printer is used to craft essential gear and upgrades specific to the extraction mode, but in multiplayer this device offers random weapon blueprints.
title: CoD: Modern Warfare 4 Players Discover A Secret Gun Printer In Multiplayer

author: Callum Self
description:
War. War never changes. But what does change is the price of some of the best strategy games. Total War: Warhammer 3 is a total blast, offering brilliant strategy set in the ever-excellent fantasy Warhammer universe, and you can grab the game and its DLC for less than ever right now, including the newly launched Lords of the End Times expansion.

As someone who doesn’t play the Warhammer (or Warhammer 40,000) tabletop games, the video games based on the franchise are some of my favorites. Vermintide? Absolute banger. Mechanicus remains one of my most-played strategy experiences (we don’t talk about the sequel here). Total War: Warhammer 3, however, feels the most impressive, both in the sheer scale of its battles and in how fun it is to control your own army.
title: Total War: Warhammer 3 And DLC Are Cheaper Than Ever, And The Chaos Gods Approve

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Helldivers 2 has been a huge hit for developer Arrowhead and publisher Sony, but don't expect a third game in the series anytime soon.

title: Why There Won’t Be A Helldivers 3 Anytime Soon, If Ever

author: Mark Delaney
description:
It was a devastating gut punch when I sat down earlier this year to write about Paranormal Activity: Threshold only to discover it had been canceled and I'd missed the news. I'm not a huge fan of the movie series, though I do like the first few entries. Instead, my enthusiasm came from who was making the game: DarkStone Digital, creator of The Mortuary Assistant.

I find The Mortuary Assistant to be among the scariest games ever made, and I credit much of its effectiveness to its impeccable sound design, something the found-footage series relies on, too. DarkStone D
title: The Scariest Game Of The Year Is This Demo For A Game That Isn’t Coming Out

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Almost six years after launch, Cyberpunk 2077 still has a healthy player base, especially with a new anime spin-off driving people to the Night City source material. The second season of Edgerunners launched last week alongside a beefy update for Cyberpunk 2077, and unsurprisingly, PC player numbers have spiked.

At the time of writing, Cyberpunk 2077 player numbers had surged to 187,215 players on PC via Steam alone. That's the biggest peak since October 2023, when the game received the substantial Update 2.0 and the Phantom Liberty expansion. This new tick in players is likely being experienced on other PC platforms where the game is available (like GOG and the Epic Games Store), as well as on
title: Cyberpunk 2077 Hits Its Biggest Steam Player Peak Since Phantom Liberty, And You Can Guess Why

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Arkane Lyon has received a slight reprieve from its looming deadline to find a new buyer, as Microsoft says it is exploring allowing another company to support the developer's efforts to get Marvel's Blade over the finish line.

Originally, it was reported that Arkane Lyon had until November 18 to find a new owner or risk the studio being shut down. Microsoft had initially announced that it was divesting itself of the developer--and several others--earlier this year, but under French Law, it was legally required
title: Arkane Lyon Gets Another Chance To Find A New Home And Finish Marvel’s Blade

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Microsoft has announced a new way to subscribe to Xbox Game Pass, and it's part of your phone plan.

T-Mobile has announced a new offering called "T-Mix," and it allows users to pick and choose the services they want included in their plan--one of the options is Xbox Game Pass.

T-Mix rolls out in November, and at that point, people can choose Game P
title: Xbox Game Pass Is Now Included With A Phone Plan

author: Eddie Makuch
description:

Vice City Bean has partnered with Rockstar Games for a new blend called Leonida, but it's not cheap. A 10oz bag of beans is going for $23, and that's before shipping costs if you don't live close to one of Vice City Bean's three locations in Miami. You can also get the coffe
title: GTA 6 Coffee Is Here To Keep You Warm Until The Game Releases

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
The upcoming Call of Duty movie aims to show the "cost of war," according to director Peter Berg. He told ComicBook that the film, set in the Modern Warfare universe, will strive to capture the spirit of those games, which means lots of guns and violence, but also heart and soul.

"So Mod
title: Call Of Duty Movie Will Not Be About, “Hey, Let’s Shoot Them All Up,” Director Says

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Bringing From Software's Elden Ring to life on the big screen is no small feat, and it won't be cheap. A new report claims the upcoming Alex Garland-directed film has a whopping budget of nearly $200 million, making it the most expensive movie distributor A24 has ever financed.

While that's not an unrealistic sum for a movie of this nature with so much star power, it is a rare move for A24. The Wall Street Journal reported the figure, and if true, Elden Ring's budget will eclipse A24's most expensive movie to date, the $70 million Marty Su
title: Elden Ring Movie Is Reportedly A $200 Million Gamble For A24

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Xbox's first-ever chief operating officer, Helen Chiang, has left the company after being promoted to that role just a few months ago under CEO Asha Sharma. In this job, Chiang was assigned to oversee the profitability of Xbox, and it's been looking very bleak for Xbox lately.

Given the timing of her exit, people wondered about the circumstances, and that remains unclear. Sharma confirmed Chiang's departure in a memo to staff, seen by T
title: Xbox Veteran Who Just Got Promoted Under Asha Sharma Promptly Leaves Amid Mysterious Circumstances

author: Richard Wakeling
description:
S-Game, the Chinese studio behind Phantom Blade Zero, clearly understands the core tenets of character-action games. If your melee combat isn't tight, responsive, and oozing cool, then what's the point? Some games might have better combat, but few can match Phantom Blade Zero's style. 

Every moment feels like you're in the middle of a Chinese martial-arts movie, pulling off moves that shouldn't be feasible--moves that go against what we expect from third-person action games--yet are baked into the mechanics. The game is not without issues, and they do hold it back from reaching the genre's upper echelons, but the highs are stratospheric.

title: Phantom Blade Zero’s Combat Is So Good, You Won’t Care The Story Makes No Sense

author: Max Blumenthal
description: S-Game's Wuxia-inspired combat puts you in the middle of a Chinese action movie.
title: Phantom Blade Zero’s Combat Is So Good, You Won’t Care The Story Makes No Sense | Review
